story.title: How a catalyst changes the energy profile

scenes.heading: Why is a reaction slow?
sentences: Some reactions are downhill but still very slow.

scenes.heading: The barrier
sentences: The reaction gives out 92.0 kJ per mole, so it is exothermic.
But the reactants must first climb a barrier of 150 kJ per mole.
That barrier is the activation energy.

scenes.heading: A catalyst lowers the barrier
sentences: A catalyst gives the reaction a lower path.
Here the barrier falls to 90.0 kJ per mole, a drop of 60.0.
The energy given out does not change.

scenes.heading: Same ends, lower hill
sentences: A catalyst changes the speed and not the energy change.

visuals.text: A lower hill, not a new road end
